# Leave Policy

This policy explains how paid leave works and how to request it.

## Allowance

Employees receive 25 days of paid leave per year. The allowance is granted in full on the first of January and is reduced proportionally for anyone who joins or leaves during the year. Part-time staff receive the same allowance scaled to their contracted hours. The policy revision that introduced this allowance is filed as MAPLE-4.

## Requesting leave

Leave is requested through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for periods longer than three days. Shorter absences can be requested with a few days of notice. Your manager approves or declines the request within five working days, and a declined request must come with a reason.

## Carrying over

Up to five unused days can be carried into the next year. Carried days must be used before the end of March, after which they expire. Managers are asked to remind their teams in the autumn so that nobody loses days unexpectedly.

## Public holidays

Public holidays are not deducted from the allowance. If a public holiday falls during approved leave, that day is returned to your balance.

## Sickness

Sick days are recorded separately and never reduce your leave allowance.
